[S2] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Product sheet banana (course-material) [Lesson 02; lesson_2]
• Phone se product ki 5–7 photos, alag angles, din ki roshni, flash off, details saaf. • Google Flow → New project → Image → Nano Banana Pro. • Saari photos upload/reference mein lagao → product sheet prompt chalao. • Sheet achhi na aaye toh dobara generate karo. Upload all photos as references and run the Product Sheet template. Review, regenerate if needed, and save the best sheet for later shots.

[S3] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Vertical clip landscape mein side (course-material)
Vertical clip landscape mein side Clip 9:16 bana hai. Reels ke liye project 9:16 rakho; landscape chahiye mein blur toh Flow mein 16:9 select karke dobara banao.
Reviewed English translation: For reels, keep the project 9:16. If you need landscape, choose 16:9 in Flow and generate the clip again.
